feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: England's Severn Trent has applied for a winter drought permit
entry.summary: Severn Trent's reservoirs held 49.8 percent of capacity on 20 October, and the company has applied to the Environment Agency for a permit to keep abstracting water from the River Derwent through winter. — Sources: Severn Trent Water / UK Environment Agency drought reporting, October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze cleared to the moderate band in every region today
entry.summary: A direct reading of Singapore's real-time air-quality data at midday gave 67 to 92 across the five regions. — Sources: National Environment Agency, real-time PSI data, direct fetch, 23 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's fire-hotspot count fell sharply, two days after rising
entry.summary: Indonesia's hotspot count fell to 8,973 on 20 October, down from 20,392 two days earlier, more than halving in a single day. — Sources: Ministry of Forestry/BMKG via Katadata, 20 October 2026
